title: Car accident trauma
summary: A person is badly hurt in a car crash. Many professionals help them from the roadside to recovery.

steps.label: Paramedic
steps.role: Gives emergency care at the scene and on the way to hospital.

steps.label: Medical Radiation Technologist (CT)
steps.role: Takes CT scans so the team can see injuries inside the body.

steps.label: Medical Laboratory Technologist
steps.role: Tests blood samples to help guide treatment.

steps.label: Respiratory Therapist
steps.role: Helps the patient breathe, including managing a ventilator if needed.

steps.label: Registered Practical Nurse
steps.role: Provides nursing care as the patient recovers on the hospital unit.

steps.label: Registered Kinesiologist
steps.role: Helps the patient rebuild strength and movement during rehab.

title: Pregnancy and birth
summary: A family is expecting a baby. Several professionals support the parent and newborn.

steps.label: Midwife
steps.role: Provides care during pregnancy, birth, and after the baby is born.

steps.label: Diagnostic Medical Sonographer
steps.role: Uses ultrasound to check on the baby's growth.

steps.label: Medical Laboratory Technologist
steps.role: Runs routine blood tests during pregnancy.

steps.label: Respiratory Therapist
steps.role: Supports a newborn's breathing if they need help after birth.

title: Dental and oral health
summary: An older adult needs help keeping their mouth healthy and getting new dentures.

steps.label: Dental Hygienist
steps.role: Cleans teeth and gums and teaches how to prevent problems.
